avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing topiramate levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before adding or removing

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May lower seizure threshold and reduce anticonvulsant efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Topiramate can cause hypokalemia; supplementation may mask or complicate electrolyte monitoring
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum potassium levels if used; coordinate with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Topiramate increases risk of nephrolithiasis; excessive calcium may increase stone formation risk
caution_supplements.action: Use only recommended doses; ensure adequate hydration

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and increased risk of cognitive impairment; may lower seizure threshold
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; inform prescriber of intake

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase seizure risk in susceptible individuals
caution_foods.action: Limit intake and monitor for breakthrough seizures

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum potassium, bicarbonate, and renal function regularly as topiramate is associated with metabolic acidosis and hypokalemia. Ensure adequate hydration to reduce nephrolithiasis risk, particularly if patients use calcium supplements or have dietary risk factors for kidney stones.
